messages.author: Pekka Pylväs
messages.text: Heading to the Kittilä mast site tomorrow. Last time I got stuck in the snow on the access road, any tips?

messages.author: Tiina Tuominen
messages.text: In winter the last 500 m to the Kittilä site isn't ploughed. Park at the snowmobile track sign and walk; there are snowshoes in the equipment container, padlock code 6142.

messages.author: Laura Lahti
messages.text: Can confirm, the snowshoes are on the left wall inside the container 👍
